androidtv.notes: Music plays far more formats, FLAC, Opus, WebM and Ogg included: VLC takes over when Android's own player can't play a song. New in 1.5: the Music tab.

phone.notes: Music now plays more kinds of files, FLAC, Opus, WebM and Ogg included, and links with spaces. If the phone's own player can't play a song, Codio switches to VLC.

windows.notes: Sign in to ListenBrainz (Music > Addons) and the songs you play and heart follow you across your devices.
